query:
-- Abastecimentos salvos com type=other em vez de type=fuel
SELECT 
  id,
  client_email,
  client_name,
  type,
  value / 100 as valor_reais,
  status,
  due_date,
  description
FROM bpo_charges
WHERE description LIKE 'Abastecimento%'
  AND type = 'other'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 30;
